violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a gap in the playground gate that was larger than 3 1/2 inches and smaller than 9 inches.

finding_variants.text: There was a gap in the playground gate that was larger than 3 1/2 inches and smaller than 9 inches.
Four toys on the playground were broken. Note: This was corrected at inspection when the toys were removed.

It was found during the inspection that wooden play structure had a hole on the side that was observed to be an entanglement hazard. This was corrected at the inspection when the operation covered the hole.

At the time of the inspection a play equipment structure modeled after a fire truck had warped siding that created a gap where two pieces of the siding met. This gap was small enough for children's fingers to be caught in.

A broken bicycle was observed on the playground where a group of children were playing, posing a risk of injury to the children. This was corrected during the inspection when the bicycle was removed from the playground.

A play equipment in the playground area had an opening of approximately 5.5-6 inches. The opening was due to a piece of equipment being missing.       NOTE: Maintenance personnel in the process of repairing equipment during this inspection. Equipment will not be in use until repair is completed as per Director.
